speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office; I see you have sudden abdominal pain. To help me understand what is happening, can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe would you rate it? Also, have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or urinary habits recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia.

Given your recent heart attack, the sudden belly pain, and bloody stools, I suspect your blood flow to the intestines has been blocked. Have you noticed any tenderness or a rigid abdomen when I press on it, and are you currently passing gas or having bowel movements?
